decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period expiring on 14/01/04 when the use shall cease
Condition : 2 - The as a control centre for taxi hire operations, with no customer waitng facility shall be carried on only by Mr Waheed and ER Cars
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall not be carried on between the hours of midnight and 0700 hours.
Condition : 4 - The premises shall not be used as a customer waiting area or collection point.
Condition : 5 - The premises shall not contain a drivers' rest room or any other facilities for drivers.
Condition : 6 - The display of advertisements for the taxi operations shall not take place outside the building known as 445b Great West Road.
description: Continued use of premises as control centre for taxi business for a limited  two year period.
